rv.q: Wasp Woman has its attractions, but coherence and insight aren’t among them.
Depressed because this play is such a mess on all levels that when it’s over you feel like you can finally escape thankful for having lost only two hours of your life.

cn.t: This noir-tinged drama about forgotten Hollywood tragedies proves depressing and incoherent, lacking insight despite Sean Young's presence. Critics find it a muddled downer that fails to justify its bleak subject matter.
